headline: Free rapid testing opens to everyone in England
detail: UCL encouraged twice-weekly use and kept its own Bidborough House centre for those who needed to be on campus.
quote: The Government have announced that access to free, regular, rapid coronavirus testing will be available to everyone in England from 9 April .
notes: Filed on 9 April, the national effective date; reported by UCL on 12 April. From this point UCL's own testing provision is a convenience rather than a necessity, which changes what its case counts are capturing.

headline: UCL relays advice that COVID tests do not invalidate the Ramadan fast
detail: From the Department of Health and Social Care in consultation with the British Islamic Medical Association.
quote: Their position is that LFT and PCR COVID tests do not invalidate the Ramadan fast.
notes: A testing-uptake measure aimed at a specific community, on the first day of Ramadan 2021.

headline: Remaining students told to stay away until in-person teaching resumes on 17 May
detail: With an exception for students whose mental health or wellbeing was affecting their ability to study.
quote: Students should remain where they are to continue with their studies and not return to term-time accommodation before their face-to-face teaching resumes, unless they have mental health or wellbeing challenges impacting on their ability to study successfully.
notes: An instruction not to return, which is why the on-campus student line stays flat through spring 2021 even as national restrictions eased.

headline: UCL sets a three-step return: 17 May, 21 June, then September
detail: Students and paused research from 17 May, campus fully open from 21 June, majority of staff back for part of the week from September.
quote: In line with Government guidance, all remaining staff will be able to start returning to onsite working from 21 June, ahead of the start of the 2021/22 academic year.
notes: Explicitly built on three inputs: the government roadmap, UCL's own public health experts, and staff feedback. The 21 June date later slipped by four weeks with the national step 4 delay.

headline: All remaining students may return to campus and face-to-face teaching restarts
detail: With parking, FFP2 masks, symptom-free testing and Connect to Protect offered as practical support.
quote:
From Monday 17 May all remaining students who have been
studying remotely can return to campus (including paused research projects),
and face-to-face teaching and supervision can restart.
notes: The end of the campus-closed period the blog post shades on its student figure, which runs January to 17 May 2021. Filed on 17 May, the effective date; announced 4 May.

headline: Travel permitted to Green and Amber list countries for essential reasons
detail: With quarantine costs met by UCL or the grant where travel was essential, and flexible tickets required.
quote: Staff and students may now travel on UCL business to countries that are on the Green or Amber lists for essential reasons.
notes: The first loosening since travel corridors were removed on 18 January 2021.

headline: Future of Work survey finds most staff want lasting flexibility
detail: Just over a third of staff responded. More than half reported an improved work-life blend, with commuting less and the financial effect named as gains.
quote: more than half of staff reported an overall improvement in their work-life blend and colleagues said they enjoy commuting less and the positive financial impact
notes: The evidence base for the 40% on-campus expectation set in the same issue. Response rate is stated as just over a third, so the finding is not a census.

headline: Staff to spend a minimum of 40% of working time on campus from September
detail: With the exact proportion depending on role and departmental need, and no staff required to work remotely.
quote: we will typically expect all colleagues to spend a minimum of 40% of their working time onsite from September
notes: The permanent settlement that came out of the pandemic, and the first policy in the record framed around what work should look like afterwards rather than during.

headline: Step 4 delayed four weeks and UCL's return timetable slips with it
detail: From 21 June to 19 July, with staff asked to keep working remotely until at least that date.
quote: The Government announced last night that stage four in the roadmap to ease lockdown restrictions will be delayed by four weeks, from Monday 21 June to Monday 19 July.
notes: Filed on 14 June, the date of the announcement; UCL reported it on 15 June, a one-day lag. The clearest case of a UCL date moving purely because a national date moved.

headline: Staff asked to report every test result, positive or negative, to Connect to Protect
quote: Once you receive your results, whether positive or negative, you should report your results through the NHS and through UCL’s Connect to Protect tool .
notes: UCL asking for negatives as well as positives, though only confirmed positives reach the published page. The denominator was collected but never published, which is why a positivity rate cannot be recovered from the archive.

headline: UCL encourages students to register with a GP so they can be invited for vaccination
quote: We are encouraging students to register with a GP so they can be invited to book their vaccination as the rollout continues and they become eligible.
notes: A practical obstacle specific to students: eligibility depended on GP registration, and students often were not registered locally.

headline: One-way systems removed and social distancing relaxed at step 4
detail: Most spaces returned to normal capacity, with face coverings still expected in crowded indoor areas.
quote: All remaining one-way systems will be removed and social distancing requirements will be relaxed, which will mean most spaces can return to their normal capacity.
notes: Filed on 19 July, the effective date; announced 13 July. The end of the 2 metre rule UCL had held since 8 July 2020, sixteen months earlier, including through a period when the national rule was one metre plus.

headline: Face coverings kept in all indoor spaces after legal restrictions ended
detail: Including lectures, seminar rooms, study spaces, offices and laboratories.
quote: Unless you are exempt, we expect everyone on campus to wear a face covering in indoor spaces, including in lectures, seminar rooms, study spaces, offices and labs.
notes: A second deliberate divergence from national policy in the cautious direction, a year after the 2 metre decision. Legal requirements had ended a week earlier.

headline: Testing centre moves from Bidborough House to the Student Centre at reduced scale
detail: Bidborough House closed on 30 July, with a smaller service opening at the Student Centre for those who preferred to test on site or needed help.
quote: The Lateral Flow Testing (LFT) centre on the ground floor of Bidborough House will close on Friday 30 July. A new LFT facility is due to open at the UCL Student Centre on Monday 2 August, providing a smaller-scale service
notes: A reduction in UCL's own testing capacity, once home tests were universally available. Filed on 2 August, the opening date of the replacement.

headline: Your Wellbeing survey folded into a weekly People Pulse survey
detail: After just over a year, with a one-year review published.
quote: From Monday 2 August, the Your Wellbeing survey will be phased into the weekly People Pulse survey, to help us understand how our staff are coping as we transition into hybrid working.
notes: The crisis instrument becomes a permanent one. The survey ran weekly from 22 June 2020, which is longer than the published case series.

headline: Pilot Remote Working Policy published with hybrid working guidance
quote: A new pilot Remote Working Policy and set of hybrid working FAQs have been produced to support existing guidance and policies on working from home and on campus, during the pandemic, including key dates and the expectations of our staff.

headline: NHS vaccination centre opens at UCL's Bidborough House
detail: Run by UCLH staff in partnership with UCL, open to local residents and students for first or second doses, bookable through the national system.
quote: An NHS vaccination centre has been opened at UCL’s Bidborough House site on Mabledon Place, off Euston Road, giving local residents and students the ability to book an appointment in the heart of Camden.
notes: The same building that housed the asymptomatic testing centre, and before that staff offices given over to student study space. The third repurposing of one building in a year.

headline: Face covering policy reviewed by senior management and deliberately kept
detail: Staff had raised concerns about wearing coverings all day, and the Senior Management Team decided to maintain the requirement pending a further review on 22 October.
quote: However, we have determined that our current approach should be maintained, because it is an important way to help keep our community as safe as possible as larger numbers of staff and students return to campus.
notes: A documented decision rather than a default, which is what makes it usable as evidence that UCL chose to stay stricter than the law required.

headline: All remaining staff expected back on campus from the start of term
detail: With an expectation of at least 40% of working time on site, agreed individually with line managers.
quote: From the start of term on 27 September, UCL expects all remaining staff to return to work from our buildings.
notes: Filed on 27 September, the effective date; announced 14 September. Eighteen months after the closure of 20 March 2020, and the point at which campus population returns to something like normal — which is the context for the Omicron peak three months later.

headline: Ventilation reworked across campus with a CO2 monitoring trial
detail: Air recirculation turned off in mechanically ventilated rooms, full fresh air supplied, maintenance brought forward before the autumn term.
quote: In rooms with mechanical ventilation, air recirculation has been turned off and full fresh air is being supplied;
notes: A physical infection-control measure rather than a behavioural one, and the only one in the record that changed the buildings themselves.

headline: Department for Education says students may decline face coverings
detail: Setting departmental guidance against UCL's own expectation that everyone wear one indoors.
quote: Although this is UCL’s position, the Department for Education has said that students can choose not to wear face coverings and they must not miss out on educational sessions if they do so.
notes: An explicit conflict between UCL policy and national guidance, stated in the newsletter. UCL kept its expectation but could not enforce it against students, which is the clearest limit on institutional autonomy anywhere in the record.

headline: COVID-19 Visitor Policy withdrawn
detail: Visitors still signed in but were no longer required to declare symptoms or register the areas they visited.
quote: The COVID-19 Visitor Policy is no longer in effect.
notes: Ends the contact-tracing regime for visitors introduced on 24 August 2020.

headline: Face coverings expected during classroom teaching for the new academic year
detail: With no evidence required from anyone exempt, and a review scheduled for 22 October 2021.
quote: All staff, students and visitors are expected to wear face coverings whilst indoors in all UCL buildings including during classroom teaching, unless they are exempt.
notes: The policy in force at the start of the academic year that ends with the Omicron peak of December 2021.
